relations.rationale: Jun's age doesn't logically imply Jun would set a pace others follow, though it could suggest leadership; the claims are not directly connected in content.
Both describe relative ages within the group and are consistent, with Jun being oldest supporting the idea that someone else (Yara) is youngest.
Jun setting a pace and Yara tracking time are different activities without a direct causal or logical link.
Esme and Eli being on different teams implies there are at least two teams, which is consistent with there being three teams.
Stopping for lunch at midday and settling into tents by evening are sequential events in the same journey, with the former supporting the narrative continuity leading to the latter.
Yara tracking time to ensure arrival before sunset aligns with and supports the idea that the group would quicken pace to reach camp faster.
Gathering clouds directly motivate the group to quicken their pace as stated.
Quickening pace toward the campsite logically leads to the group successfully settling into their tents by evening.
Being tired but satisfied after settling into tents supports the idea that the group was ready to rest before continuing.
